title: CarrierCostRecord
description: The ERP's record of one Carrier cost (Canonical Model document, version 1): what CarrierCostIncurred carries, kept as the TMS froze it, with the status of the Carrier cost. The ERP never recalculates it. A Carrier cost is Open until a Carrier invoice line is Matched or Accepted against it, then Invoiced; there is one per Carrier booking number.

carrierBookingNumber.description: The TMS's number for the Confirmed Carrier booking that carried the Shipment.

carrierBookingReference.description: The Carrier's own reference for the booking, which a Carrier invoice line quotes.

total.description: The sum of the charge lines, without VAT.

source.description: Where the Carrier cost came from, as CarrierCostIncurred carried it: the Carrier Rate Card version, or Spot with the Planner's remark.

remark.description: The Planner's remark with the Spot price. Present for Spot only.

deliveryTime.description: When the Shipment was Delivered, with the offset of where it happened.

correlationId.description: The correlation ID CarrierCostIncurred carried, which the Carrier cost keeps.

recordedAt.description: When the ERP recorded the Carrier cost.

status.description: Open until a Carrier invoice line is Matched or Accepted against the Carrier cost, then Invoiced.
